requirement.description: The HTTP/2 hook implementation is incomplete and does not properly capture and populate HTTP/2 request/response data. Many tests are failing because the HTTP/2 records are not being properly populated with actual request and response data.
requirement.contract: Update the HTTP/2 hook implementation to properly capture HTTP/2 request and response data by intercepting actual HTTP/2 connection events. The hook should correctly populate HTTP2Record objects with: 1. Method, URL, headers, and content from HTTP/2 requests 2. Status code, headers, and content from HTTP/2 responses 3. Proper handling of HTTP/2 pseudo-headers (:method, :path, :authority, :status) 4. Support for both synchronous and asynchronous HTTP/2 clients
requirement.acceptance: test_h2, test_h2_request, test_h2_response, test_h2_cookies, test_h2_client_redirect, test_h2_client_not_found, test_h2_client_get_empty_request_content, test_h2_client_many_requests, test_h2_client_many_requests_session, test_h2_client_asyncclient, test_h2_server, test_h2_server_only, test_h2_server_request, test_h2_server_response, test_h2_initiator

requirement.description: The HTTP2Record class is missing proper data population mechanisms. It relies on stub implementations that don't actually capture real HTTP/2 data from the underlying HTTP/2 connection.
requirement.contract: Enhance the HTTP2Record class to properly capture and store HTTP/2 data from actual HTTP/2 connections. Specifically: 1. Implement proper HTTP/2 frame parsing to extract real request/response data 2. Ensure the receive_data/send_data methods correctly accumulate data from HTTP/2 frames 3. Implement proper handling of HTTP/2 pseudo-headers and standard headers 4. Fix the URL construction logic to properly parse :authority and :path pseudo-headers
requirement.acceptance: test_h2, test_h2_request, test_h2_response, test_h2_cookies, test_h2_client_redirect, test_h2_client_not_found, test_h2_client_get_empty_request_content, test_h2_client_many_requests, test_h2_client_many_requests_session, test_h2_client_asyncclient, test_h2_server, test_h2_server_only, test_h2_server_request, test_h2_server_response, test_h2_initiator

requirement.description: The hook implementation does not integrate with HTTP/2 connection event handlers to capture actual request/response data. The current implementation only creates placeholders but doesn't populate them with real HTTP/2 data.
requirement.contract: Modify the hook implementation to properly connect with HTTP/2 connection handlers that will populate the HTTP/2 records with real data. The system should: 1. Store references to HTTP/2 records during hook execution 2. Allow HTTP/2 connection handlers to access and populate these records 3. Handle both synchronous and asynchronous HTTP/2 connections properly

requirement.description: The HTTP2Record class does not correctly implement the protocol property and lacks proper exception handling for status code extraction.
requirement.contract: Fix the protocol property in HTTP2Record to consistently return "HTTP/2" and improve the status_code and reason properties to properly handle HTTP/2 status codes and exceptions: 1. Ensure protocol property always returns "HTTP/2" 2. Improve status_code property to correctly extract :status pseudo-header 3. Improve reason property to handle HTTP/2 status codes appropriately 4. Add proper fallbacks when pseudo-headers are missing
